title: DistributedTaskQueueSystem
description: This project implements a distributed task queue in Python — a system that lets a web API accept long-running jobs and hand them off to background workers, so the API stays responsive while the heavy work happens elsewhere.

title: NovaTrade-Testnet-Terminal
description: A real-time cryptocurrency trading platform built on event-driven microservices architecture. Uses Redis Pub/Sub for async order execution, WebSockets for live updates, and Binance Testnet for simulated trading, all connected via a Next.js frontend.

title: TechBoss
description: Tech Boss is a Visual Studio Code extension that leverages Google's Gemini AI to help you modify and generate code intelligently. Simply describe what you want, and let AI do the heavy lifting!

title: Codecast
description: Real-time collaborative code editor with multi-user support in shared rooms, featuring instant synchronization across clients with syntax highlighting.

title: AutoSubAI
description: Built a CLI tool using yt-dlp and OpenAI Whisper to automatically generate .vtt subtitle files from YouTube videos. Integrated audio extraction, model selection (tiny–large), and optional translation workflows, delivering an end-to-end automated transcription pipeline.

title: VectorShiftAssignment
description: A full-stack pipeline visualization and validation tool built with React Flow and FastAPI. Create node-based workflows with real-time DAG validation, dynamic node abstractions, and visual pipeline analysis.
